name: BookingSmsSettings
description: EasyBook — Settings · "Trimitere SMS": how the business's SMS leave (Ventora, the business phone, or off), the business phone's live state, what happens when the phone isn't available, and the sending hours. A new tab of BookingSettings, between "Reamintiri" and "Rezervări online". Built only from existing components (SheetSection, RadioGroup, StatusDot, Stat, Toggle, DatePicker, Notice, UsageMeter, AccessBadge, Dialog, Toast).
